# T-1: Define upgrade artifact contract

## Goal
Add shared constants, paths, schema validation, and bounded raw-log handling for upgrade-result.json and tests/.raw/upgrade.log.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Required upgrade-result.json fields from R1 are validated.
- result values are limited to no_changes, updated, and failed.
- rawLogPath must point to tests/.raw/upgrade.log.
- Raw log validation rejects missing, empty, or oversized upgrade.log files.
- Artifact validation has bounded file size and bounded array checks.

## Implementation Notes
Prefer a dedicated value class or cohesive helper functions near existing artifact classes/helpers in test-artifacts.js. Keep upgrade evidence separate from test-execute schema.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local unit tests with `// spec: R1 R2 R3 R6` validate accepted and rejected upgrade artifact shapes, raw log validity, and failure reason content.
